article.title: The truth behind the America-Israel relationship. It isn’t what you think.
article.author: Sana Saeed
article.content: In Episode 1 of The Necessary State, Sana Saeed traces how American support for Israel went from cautious and transactional in the 1950s to the untouchable consensus it is today.
